answer_1.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on two corpora from the low-resource MATERIAL program, and on bitext from GlobalVoices... We propose Simulated Multiple Reference Training (SMRT), which significantly improves performance in low-resource settings—by 1.2 to 7.0 BLEU—and is complementary to back-translation.

answer_2.quote: Our method improves over the baseline in all settings, by between 1.2 and 7.0 BLEU (all statistically significant at the 95% confidence level). All BLEU scores are SacreBLEU.
